role_summary: The Forward-Deployed Data Scientist at Braze is a technical expert who designs and builds end-to-end machine learning solutions that power 1-to-1 personalization for leading global brands. The role involves owning the full ML pipeline from raw data through model deployment, partnering with customers and internal product teams, and helping shape BrazeAI's product strategy and roadmap.
